summary: Iter 22 P0 stabilization sprint frontend validation. Tested sidebar collapse, library panel collapse, brand logo, mode toggle, CSS contrast vars, no-horizontal-scroll, duplicate user profile removal, layers panel. Slider drag stability could not be fully exercised (image block sliders require selecting an image-type block — the Note block was selected by default and Note inspector exposes only a textarea, not adj-*/block-* sliders). All other Iter-22 acceptance criteria PASSED.

minor.issue: Console showed 503 on a few resource calls during navigation to /moodboards/<id> via direct URL; clicking through the card from /moodboards list works reliably.
Console showed 403 on a few non-blocking resource calls on dashboard load (did not affect functional flow).

workspace_mode_toggle.note: Mode toggle is in editor topbar only (not dashboard topbar). data-workspace-mode flips light<->dark, localStorage 'mfd_workspace_mode' updates, brand-logo opacities swap (dark=1/light=0 in dark; expected reversed in light).

layers_panel.drop_indicator_test: NOT_OBSERVED — mouse drag did not surface 'layer-drop-indicator-above/below' testids in DOM during drag. Likely needs pointer events or HTML5 dragstart instead of plain mousedown/move.

slider_drag_stability.reason: When tab-layers was opened and first layer-row was clicked, a NOTE block was selected by default. Note inspector renders only a textarea (no adj-* / block-* sliders). Subsequent attempts to click other layer rows (image/palette/shape blocks) timed out due to elapsed test budget.
slider_drag_stability.slider_testids_present_when_note_selecte: 0/11 (expected — Note block has no image adjustments)
slider_drag_stability.recommendation: Main agent / next testing agent should programmatically select an image-type block (e.g. data-block-id with type=image) before asserting slider drag stability. The remount-observer harness is in place — re-run it after selecting an image block.

action_items: Validate slider drag stability against an explicitly selected image block (the Note block has no sliders). Recommend exposing data-testid='canvas-block-image-<id>' or filter layers by type in test.

Verify layer drop indicators surface during drag — current implementation may rely on HTML5 drag events (dragover) rather than mouse events. Consider documenting which event family triggers indicators.
Minor: investigate intermittent 503/403 console errors on dashboard / direct moodboard URL navigation.
critical_code_review_comments: BlockInspector slider remount fix: cropFocalJsx/adjustmentsJsx/visualPropsJsx as JSX expressions instead of inline component declarations is the correct React pattern — remount observers were ready but block-type prevented direct verification this run.
useSidebarCollapsed + useLibraryCollapsed hooks correctly persist to localStorage and restore on reload (validated).
Brand layered with CSS opacity swap is well-implemented (both images preloaded, swapped via .brand-mark--dark/--light classes).
Sidebar no longer leaks user PII (no @ symbol in sidebar text — confirmed).
data-workspace-mode is only present on editor pages; dashboard has it null but CSS vars still resolve via :root default — confirm this is intentional (no light-mode flicker on dashboard).
seed_data_creation: Used existing moodboard 85b93c6b-8de2-4b14-a977-a768ecc02309 (TEST_F1_UI_lux). No new seed data created.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow: fill #email + #password then press Enter (submit button click sometimes does not trigger SPA navigation — Enter key works). To reach editor reliably: visit /moodboards, click the 'TEST_F1_UI_lux' card text. Direct /moodboards/<id> sometimes 503s on first load. For slider tests: click tab-layers, layer-rows are listed in z-order — index 0 in this moodboard is a NOTE block. Iterate rows checking for [data-testid=block-opacity] presence after selecting; switch to tab-inspector after each selection. Sliders adj-* are image-only; block-opacity/rotation/border-radius should appear for most blocks.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no critical bugs found. Slider remount fix could not be directly drag-verified in this run because the selected layer was a Note block (no slider inspector). Mutation-observer harness is in code path and ready when image block is selected.
